content: Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday haysada gidi caaqishin ta si7as.

content.text: he lo77o keethatan daanaw asi dhayana.
issi oto gum7etha woyne xalaala ekana.
Hospun tammu kilo giraame zerida gadepe,
tammanne hospun kilo giraame xalaala ekana” yaagis.
Hiza ta asay akeeka dhayida gisho, di7etana;
ayseysati koshan hayqana; asay saamon xuugetana.
Yerusalaamen de7iya gita asaa, daro asaa,

content: Asi tooshetana; asa koche ubbay kawuyana; otortiya ubbay guuxana.
Shin Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday, ba suure pirdan dhoqu dhoqu gaana; Xoossaa geeshshatethay iya xillotethan qoncana.
He wode dorsati he bessan heemetana; dorsa urgeti laaletida keetha bessatan maana.
Cimo wodoron nagara, gaare wodoron iitatethi goocheyisata ayye!
“Ane Xoossay elleso! Nuuni be7ana mela ba oosuwa eesoyo! Nuuni erana mela Isra7eele Geeshshay qopida qofaa polo” yaageyisata ayye!
Iitaa lo77o, lo77uwa iita; dhumaa poo7o, poo7uwa dhuma; camuwa mal7o, mal7uwa camo geyisata ayye!
Woyne ushshan eretida asaanne mathoyiya ushshu walakanaw wozani mino gidida asaa ayye!
Qohida uraa xillisanaw wodhaafe ekidi, xillo asaa suure pirdaa geellayeyisata ayye!

Enti Ubbaafe Wolqaama Godaa higgiya ixida gishonne Isra7eele Geeshshaa qaala kadhida gisho tama lacoy kale oykeysadanne buurey taman meetetidi dhayeysada enta xaphoy wooqana. Enta ciishshay baanada laaletidi dhayana.

Hessa gisho, Godaa hanqoy iya asaa bolla eexis; iya kushey dendidi, enta dhaysis. Dereti qaaxidosona; hayqida asaa ahay oge bolla buureda hanis. He ubbanka iya hanqoy simmibeenna; iya kushey ha77ika dendida bessan de7ees.
Goday haaho son de7iya kawotethatas malla dhoqan essis; sa7aa gaxan de7iya asaa suyqidi xeegis; enti dirgishe puttu goosona.
Enta giddon daabureynne dhubetey baawa; entafe issoyka dhiskenna woyko zin7enna. Xeessan dancida saqey birshetena; enta caamma wodoroy duuxenna.
Enta tooray qara; enta dongeyka waaxetidi de7ees. Enta parata tohoy qara shucha mela; enta para gaareta gertoy gote mela.
Enti gaammo mela guummoosona; wodala gaammo mela gudoosona. Enti sarbuqishe miyaba oykidi, tooki ekidi boosona; entafe wothidi ekey oonika baawa.
He wode enti gita abba guunthada Isra7eele bolla guummana. Issi asi he biitta xeelliya wode dhuminne waayey be7ana; poo7oy shaaran mitettana.
